title: Programming Foundations III
description: Reason about algorithms, architecture, asynchronous systems, security, performance and capstone design.
overview: This advanced foundations course connects code-level decisions to whole-system behaviour. You will compare algorithm costs, use recursion deliberately, design boundaries and dependencies, reason about APIs and asynchronous work, protect data, measure performance and plan a capstone. It prepares learners for specialised study rather than attempting to replace a full computer-science programme.
